v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
text.en: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

text.la: Maiórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
text.en: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

text.la: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

text.la: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
text.en: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

text.la: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
text.en: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

text.la: Fratres: Iam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Iesu.
text.en: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Vos qui reliquístis * ómnia, et secúti estis me, céntuplum accipiétis, et vitam ætérnam possidébitis.
text.en: You who left all * and follow me, you will receive hundredfolds, and you will have eternal life.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Matthíam Apostolórum tuórum collégio sociásti: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut, eius interventióne, tuæ circa nos pietátis semper víscera sentiámus.
text.en: O God, Who added blessed Matthias to the company of Thy Apostles; grant, we beseech Thee, that by his intercession we may ever be aware of the depth of Thy love for us.

title.la: Feria Quarta infra Hebdomadam II in Quadragesima
title.en: Feria Quarta infra Hebdomadam II in Quadragesima

text.la: Ecce ascéndimus Ierosólymam: et Fílius hóminis tradétur ad crucifigéndum.
text.en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and the Son of man shall be betrayed to be crucified.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Pópulum tuum, quǽsumus, Dómine, propítius réspice: et quos ab escis carnálibus prǽcipis abstinére, a nóxiis quoque vítiis cessáre concéde.
text.en: Look down in mercy upon thy people, O Lord, we beseech thee, and grant unto them, whom Thou commandest to abstain from fleshly meats, power to abstain also from the corruption of sin.
